subject.title: Bug: 升级后 Dashboard 历史会话索引/映射错乱

question: What evidence and repair policy should OpenClaw require before relinking a Dashboard session key to a preserved transcript or trajectory file?
rationale: The source path shows the wrong-row failure mode, but choosing a preserved file from corrupted state can misattach private history, so automation should not select the permanent recovery policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Require a redacted fixture first
options.body: Keep this open until a redacted sessions.json plus transcript or trajectory fixture proves the wrong mapping and can drive a conservative doctor/diagnostic repair.

options.title: Ship read-only diagnostics first
options.body: Add tooling that reports suspected mismatches and orphan candidates without mutating mappings until an operator confirms the recovery target.

options.title: Allow heuristic relink
options.body: Permit automated relinking from best-effort content or timestamp matches, accepting higher risk of attaching a Dashboard key to the wrong historical file.

recommendation.title: Require a redacted fixture first
recommendation.body: Keep this open until a redacted sessions.json plus transcript or trajectory fixture proves the wrong mapping and can drive a conservative doctor/diagnostic repair.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the strongest current-history routing candidate for the session/gateway read path in the available checkout history.
